content.title: The technical challenges TAE will face while building fusion plant
content.description:
Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT, DJTWW) — the parent company of social media platform Truth Social — announced its plans to merge with nuclear energy startup TAE Technologies in a deal that could be valued up to $6 billion. TAE seeks to begin construction of its fusion power plant in 2026.

Futurum CEO Daniel Newman lays out the more technical problems TAE may face in plotting out its fusion power plant.

Also catch Daniel Newman weigh in on TAE's "very, very ambitious" construction timeline for its fusion power project.

content.title: DJT Stock Rises More Than 40%, Biggest Gain Since January 2024
content.summary: Trump Media & Technology (DJT) shares jumped 42% Thursday after the president’s social-media company agreed to merge with fusion-power company TAE Technologies.  After news of the all-stock deal came out, DJT shares pulled off their biggest one-day gain since January 2024, before it converted from Digital World Acquisition Corp. to Trump Media as part of an earlier merger.  The deal announced Thursday is valued at $6 billion and seeks to capitalize on the artificial-intelligence boom’s growing power requirements.
